versions.changelog:
Cloud Compliance Checker 1.0.0 initial release

- Launches an API for auditing cloud configurations against industry compliance standards.
- Supports major providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes) and frameworks (CIS, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOX, NIST, ISO27001).
- Provides detailed compliance results with check breakdowns and reporting on failures.
- Designed for use by DevSecOps, security engineers, and compliance auditors for automated and on-demand assessments.
- Includes tiered pricing: Free, Developer, Professional, and Enterprise options.
